body:
Good point. Done.

However it turns out there is a bug in the fuzzy searching where it doesn't work to disable case sensitivity. I made another PR to fix this. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105900

It could be good to add a new public field `FuzzySearchResult::original_index` to avoid needing hashmaps for post processing. Originally I wanted to template it for arbitrary types of targets, for ease of associating data with the results, but it seemed overkill at that point.
yes that would be graet. I was very much missing that when I added this.
would you like me to make a pr for that or do you want to do that as part of these prs?

If you have the time to do a PR for that it would be great, you'd probably make a cleaner implementation that fits with what's already there. I can mark these two as Drafts and then update them to use the new functionality when yours is merged.
